sloka: चिरम् जीवितुमाशम्से रुदतीम् चापि मैथिलीम् ।सा नूनम् विधवा राज्यम् सपुत्रा कारयिष्यसि ॥२-१२-७५॥
transliteration: ciram jīvitumāśamse rudatīm cāpi maithilīm ।sā nūnam vidhavā rājyam saputrā kārayiṣyasi ॥2-12-75॥

translations.english: O Devi you will certainly rule the kingdom as a widow along with your son. (But) I do not wish to live after Rama is exiled.
